content.title: Update specs/roadmap/expertise docs for new webapp ports
content.description:
The webapp port standardization (parent mqh2h99uob, implementation mqh2hwulrt) moved dev API to 3001 / dev vite to 3000 / E2E API to 5001 / E2E vite to 5000. The following non-code docs still reference old ports and need refreshing for guidance accuracy (section D of the prescription, comment mqh2nfnt2o):

- .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md:
  - Line 724: `const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;` -> 3001
  - Line 762: env table row `| PORT | 3000 | Server port |` -> 3001
  - Lines 768-779 (section 4.6 Dev server setup): currently says Vite on 5173 proxying to Hono on 3000; rewrite to vite on 3000 proxying /api to Hono on 3001, and update the embedded vite.config.ts snippet accordingly.
- .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md line 35: "Configure Vite proxy for /api -> http://localhost:3000" -> 3001
- .agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/webapp-server-ports.expertise.md: verify and update any documented port values to match the new dev (3001/3000) and E2E (5001/5000) ports.

These files are read-only for webapp-developer and outside its domain, so could not be updated as part of mqh2hwulrt. Assigning to project-manager for triage/assignment to the appropriate agent (likely webapp-validator for the expertise file, and whoever owns the specs).
